cat.box.pet:
You slide your hand into the box,
feeling the pleasant cat fur at hand.
At that very second, the cat slips away from you.
You reach into the box, feeling the pleasant cat fur at hand.
At that very second, the cat slips away from you.
As if it doesn't exist
cat.box.feed:
You pour a handful of food into the box.
Loud rustling is heard, the box shakes...

and that's it
cat.box.play:
The emptiness of the box openly stares at you,
these yellow eyes look at you, at your toy
and disappear into the bottomless fog
cat.box.time: It seems there is no time in the box...
cat.box.yearly_vet_lab:
You bring the box to the vet.
She looks inside for a long time — it even feels awkward,
you didn't have the courage for that.
Then she replies that the cat isn't there...
And the cat looks at you rudely from the box
cat.box.joke_0: Any joke about box can be both funny and unfunny at once

cat.dead.yearly_vet_lab: I fear we cant help you... Try later
